chunks: Whatever is in it from Yāsir al-Khādim, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Yāsir, the servant of al-Riḍā عليه السلام.

key_terms.خَادِمِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: servant of Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام; identifies Yāsir’s association
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates direct authorial attribution of the report
key_terms.يَاسِرِ الْخَادِمِ: Yāsir the servant, the named transmitter in this chain

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Yāsir, the servant of Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام, in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad for reports transmitted from Yāsir, the servant of Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام, in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. It identifies the chain through the author's father, then ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, then his father, ending with Yāsir.
